scope: Equation-level bearing-rotation assay; no claim of reproducing authors optimizer or testing full metric VO
source_frames: Existing exposed rain _2021-08-06-16-19-00 stems000000..000019; all19 adjacent slots retained
primary_candidate: PNEC_original_pixel_covariance on original means; replacement population is fixed secondary diagnostic and cannot rescue failed primary
covariance_propagation: First-order Jacobian to unit target bearings, rank2; source points conditioned on

optimizer.implementation: SciPy least_squares joint5parameters; target-to-source rotation, unit translation direction tangent chart
optimizer.initialization: Eight-point geometry and cheirality, no reference/native-pose initialization

planned_geometric_filter.implementation: OpenCV essential-matrix RANSAC, must be numerically tested/source-frozen before real execution
planned_geometric_filter.support: Intersect original/replacement inlier masks on already joint finite/inbound/SPD grid, keep same source points for every objective and both means
planned_geometric_filter.multiple_essential_solutions: retain explicit unavailable if result is not a single3x3; no outcome-selected solution
planned_geometric_filter.missing: retain slot and reason; no retry or threshold adjustment

planned_rotation_target: Inherited nominal supplied-reference common interval; optical target-to-source rotation transformed with the same declared frame rotation and actual duration ratio as native baseline. Existing available horizon preserved; no metric translation invented.
translation_direction: Not a primary endpoint; unavailable until an exact camera-local interval/reference conversion is supplied. Unit t cannot be carried through a translated sensor frame without metric scale. No GT-scale borrowing.
primary_rain_decision: Mechanical/development gate only: lower rotation mean AND RMSE than NEC on identical support, <=native thermal on matched nominal intervals, no lower coverage than NEC. Frozen before candidate solves/scoring. Failure stops this prototype configuration.
transfer_decision: No training promotion based on rain. Before any day/night candidate solve, freeze existing first20-group exposed packets and identical code/controls; require per-recording gains and no coverage regression. Not an automatic follow-up.
execution_budget: one attempt for each of 19 slots x2 means x3 objectives =114 solves maximum on rain. No kernel, covariance, regularization, frame, initialization or threshold search. Failed/degenerate slots count.
limitations: First-order propagation and local joint solver differ from original paper unscented plus alternating SCF/globalization. Negative results do not reject PNEC/DNLS as published methods.
